content: MAST (Multi-Agent System Failure Taxonomy, UC Berkeley + IBM, arXiv 2503.13657) analysed 1600+ traces across 7 multi-agent frameworks, 14 failure modes in 3 categories: system design issues 44.2% (disobeying task spec, disobeying ROLE spec, step repetition, loss of conversation history, unaware of termination conditions), inter-agent misalignment 32.3%, and task verification failures (incorrect/insufficient verification). Role-boundary violation and premature termination are top offenders.
